data.gender_notes: Herawi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-r-w', meaning 'the sun'. The name Herawi carries the meaning “The Sun” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Herawi usually hope their child will grow to embody the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Herawi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
